DHCPScope is a DHCPv4 address pool served by kudurru in Kubernetes. Leases are DHCPLease objects (dhcp.kudurru.io); one replica allocates at a time.

| | |
|---|---|
| API version | `kudurru.io/v1alpha1` |
| Kind | `DHCPScope` |
| Scope | Cluster |
| Resource | `dhcpscopes.kudurru.io` |
| Short names | `dhcpscope` |
| Subresources | `status` |

Columns of `kubectl get dhcpscopes`:

| Column | Type | Value |
|---|---|---|
| SUBNET | string | `.spec.subnet` |
| LEASES | integer | `.status.activeLeases` |
| SERVING | string | `.status.servingPod` |
| READY | string | `.status.conditions[?(@.type=="Ready")].status` |
| AGE | date | `.metadata.creationTimestamp` |

## Spec

DHCPScopeSpec is one DHCPv4 address pool and the options its clients receive. Clients reach kudurru through the trusted relays; the server address clients see is a node setting (dhcp.serverIP), shared by every scope.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `spec.bootFile` | `string` | Length: at most 128 |
| `spec.bootProfiles` | `[]object` | Items: at most 32 |
| `spec.bootProfiles[].architecture` | `integer` | **Required.**<br>Format: `int32`<br>Range: 0 to 65535 |
| `spec.bootProfiles[].bootFile` | `string` | Length: at most 128 |
| `spec.bootProfiles[].bootServer` | `string` | Length: at most 15 |
| `spec.bootProfiles[].bootServerName` | `string` | Length: at most 64 |
| `spec.bootServer` | `string` | Length: at most 15 |
| `spec.bootServerName` | `string` | Length: at most 64 |
| `spec.classlessRoutes` | `[]object` | Items: at most 32 |
| `spec.classlessRoutes[].destination` | `string` | **Required.**<br>Length: at most 18 |
| `spec.classlessRoutes[].router` | `string` | **Required.**<br>Length: at most 15 |
| `spec.conflictDetection` | `string` | ConflictDetection probes a new address before offering it: icmp (default; needs NET\_RAW) or disabled.<br>One of: `auto`, `icmp`, `disabled` |
| `spec.dnsServers` | `[]string` | **Required.** DNSServers are the IPv4 DNS servers advertised to clients.<br>Items: 1 to 63 |
| `spec.dnsTTL` | `string` | DNSTTL is the TTL of those records, from 1s to 1h, clamped to the remaining lease time.<br>Default: `30s` |
| `spec.domainName` | `string` | DomainName is the client domain, also the domain of local DNS records when registerDNS is set.<br>Length: at most 253 |
| `spec.domainSearch` | `[]string` | Items: at most 32 |
| `spec.leaseDuration` | `string` | LeaseDuration is in whole seconds, from one minute to 30 days.<br>Default: `12h` |
| `spec.ntpServers` | `[]string` | Items: at most 63 |
| `spec.probeTimeout` | `string` | ProbeTimeout bounds the ICMP probe; default 200ms. |
| `spec.rangeEnd` | `string` | **Required.**<br>Length: at most 15 |
| `spec.rangeStart` | `string` | **Required.** RangeStart and RangeEnd bound the dynamic pool, inclusive.<br>Length: at most 15 |
| `spec.registerDNS` | `boolean` | RegisterDNS publishes A and PTR records for bound leases on every replica. |
| `spec.reservations` | `[]object` | Reservations assign fixed addresses to MAC addresses.<br>Items: at most 4096 |
| `spec.reservations[].hostname` | `string` | Length: at most 253 |
| `spec.reservations[].ip` | `string` | **Required.**<br>Length: at most 15 |
| `spec.reservations[].mac` | `string` | **Required.**<br>Length: at most 17 |
| `spec.router` | `string` | **Required.** Router is the default gateway advertised to clients.<br>Length: at most 15 |
| `spec.subnet` | `string` | **Required.** Subnet is the client IPv4 subnet in canonical CIDR form; it must not overlap another scope.<br>Length: at most 18 |
| `spec.trustedRelays` | `[]object` | **Required.** TrustedRelays are the relays allowed to forward this subnet's clients. At least one is required.<br>Items: 1 to 64 |
| `spec.trustedRelays[].gatewayIP` | `string` | **Required.** GatewayIP is the giaddr the relay writes for this subnet; it is never allocated.<br>Length: at most 15 |
| `spec.trustedRelays[].linkSelection` | `string` | LinkSelection is the exact RFC 3527 link selection address the relay sends, inside this subnet; empty refuses the extension.<br>Length: at most 15 |
| `spec.trustedRelays[].serverIdentifier` | `string` | ServerIdentifier is the exact RFC 5107 server identifier override the relay sends; empty refuses the extension.<br>Length: at most 15 |
| `spec.trustedRelays[].sourceIP` | `string` | **Required.** SourceIP is the IPv4 source address of the relay's packets as kudurru receives them (the LoadBalancer Service must preserve it).<br>Length: at most 15 |
| `spec.trustedRelays[].sourcePort` | `integer` | SourcePort is the relay's UDP source port; zero means 67. An alternate port requires the RFC 8357 relay port suboption.<br>Format: `int32`<br>Range: 0 to 65535 |

## Status

DHCPScopeStatus is written by the replica that serves DHCP.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status.activeLeases` | `integer` | ActiveLeases counts bound leases. |
| `status.conditions` | `[]Condition` | List type: `map`, keyed by `type` |
| `status.conflictingLeases` | `integer` | ConflictingLeases counts live leases this spec no longer allows; they are not renewed and end at expiry. |
| `status.observedGeneration` | `integer` | Format: `int64` |
| `status.servingPod` | `string` | ServingPod is the replica that holds the DHCP allocator term. |

## Example

`deploy/kustomize/samples/kudurru.io_v1alpha1_dhcpscope.yaml`:

```yaml
# A DHCPv4 scope served in Kubernetes (dhcp.enabled in the chart). The
# router relays DHCP for 192.168.30.0/24 to the chart's dhcp.serverAddress;
# its source address and giaddr are trusted below. Annotate a scope you
# manage in Git with kudurru.io/managed-by (e.g. gitops:argocd) so the
# dashboard shows it read-only.
apiVersion: kudurru.io/v1alpha1
kind: DHCPScope
metadata:
  name: iot
  annotations:
    kudurru.io/managed-by: gitops:argocd
spec:
  subnet: 192.168.30.0/24
  rangeStart: 192.168.30.100
  rangeEnd: 192.168.30.199
  router: 192.168.30.1
  dnsServers: [192.168.10.53]
  domainName: iot.home.arpa
  leaseDuration: 12h
  registerDNS: true
  dnsTTL: 30s
  trustedRelays:
    - sourceIP: 192.168.30.1
      gatewayIP: 192.168.30.1
  reservations:
    - mac: "02:42:ac:11:00:02"
      ip: 192.168.30.10
      hostname: thermostat
```
